company.name: Banyan & Bay Foods

company.plan_note: Growth plan, 56 employees x ₹119 = ₹6,664 a month before GST, billed monthly.
company.pay_cycle: Calendar month; salary paid on the last working day
company.regime_change_policy: Banyan & Bay lets an employee change the regime used for TDS once a year, until the proof window closes on 28 Feb 2026. TDS for the months left is then recalculated. The final choice is made in the income-tax return.

structure_rule: Basic 40% of monthly CTC; HRA 50% of basic in Mumbai or New Delhi, 40% elsewhere; LTA by grade (₹3,000 G5, ₹5,000 G6 and up); employer PF 12% of basic up to ₹15,000; employer ESI 3.25% when gross is up to ₹21,000; special allowance is the balance.

types.name: Leave without pay
types.accrual: When no balance is left; deducted as loss-of-pay

policy.approval: Reporting manager approves; HR can approve on their behalf.
policy.lop_rule: Loss-of-pay days reduce every earning in proportion: earning x (days in month - LOP days) / days in month.
policy.attendance_cutoff: Leave approved by the 25th counts in that month's payroll; later approvals carry to the next month.
